meta.title: When can and can't I train
meta.description: Age and health requirements for practicing aikido. Aikido is accessible from age 14 regardless of gender or size.

header.title: When can and can't I train aikido

ageText: Generally, the reasonable minimum age is considered to be 14 years and the maximum age is up to 115 years.
accessText: Aikido is adaptable for people of different characteristics – regardless of size or gender. Aikido adapts to each individual, not the other way around.
healthText: The only serious obstacles are a severe heart condition, bone diseases, and potentially serious blood pressure problems.
safetyItems: Inform the instructor of any physical limitations
Immediately report any health issues during training
Follow the warm-up at the beginning
Follow the instructor's directions and don't be afraid to ask questions
